# Creating an Icon

![Creating an Icon Example](/assets/images/creating-an-icon_creating_an_icon_world_example-c92b218e862d5007c70138e4247ba7fd.png)

# Best Practices

The icon for a Lens should depict the content of the Lens in the most simplistic way. Below are some best practices to use when creating your Lens's icon:

* Create icon elements using vector shapes
* Use simple forms that are easy to visualize at low resolution
* Work in an illustrated, cartoon-like style
* Work in bright and clear colors
* Use sharp lines and clearly recognizable shapes
* Avoid photos and screenshots
* Deliver icons as a 320x320 PNG and use the standard frame found in the icon template

# Lens Icon

There is a variety of ways to generate a project icon:

![](/assets/images/lens-icon-starting-screen-1-29d41c2a1477160ebe8b910b04627c76.png)

## Capture from Preview[​**](#capture-from-preview "Copy to clipboard")

1. In the Lens Icon section, click on the `Capture from Preview` button.

2. Adjust crop and click `Save Changes`.

## Import from computer[​**](#import-from-computer "Copy to clipboard")

1. In the Lens Icon section, click on the `Import Image` option.

   * This will open a file browser window where you can choose an icon file from your local device.

2. Review and crop the Icon

3. Once uploaded, the icon will appear in the Lens Icon preview area.

   * Adjust the crop area as necessary to ensure a perfect fit.

4. Apply the Icon

   * Сlick `Apply` to set the imported file as the Lens icon.
   * Your custom icon will now be displayed in the `Project Settings`.

## Generate Lens icon[​**](#generate-lens-icon "Copy to clipboard")

1. You can access the `Lens Icon Generator` in the `Project Settings`:

   * In the icon generation section, you will see a prompt field.

     ![](/assets/images/generate-lens-icon-field-ba73d221d0a32964ed837293660bc618.png)

   * Type a description of the icon you want to create and press generate.

     ![](/assets/images/generate-lens-icon-field-filled-04a64270a968afb0872c89c482fec7a0.png)

2. Pick from Generated Options

   * Once the tool generates several icon options based on your prompt, you can view them and select the one that fits your needs.

   * If you don’t like any of the options, you can proceed to the next step.

     ![](/assets/images/result-of-generation-5e2111c313b3cee054810e243dee283e.png)

3. Regenerate Icons

   * If the generated options aren’t suitable, click Regenerate to create a new set of icons based on your original or modified prompt.

   * If you want to exclude certain elements from the icon, use the negative prompts feature.

     <!-- -->

     * Type in what you don’t want to appear, and the tool will adjust accordingly in the next generation.

       ![](/assets/images/negative-prompt-result-1bda959233ff521f033aa1035d8d662b.png)

4. Change Styles from the Dropdown Menu

   * The tool provides a dropdown menu with different styles.

     ![](/assets/images/styles-drop-down-078081f19983fbbf2d34e29fbdf76a5b.png)

   * Select a style that aligns with the design of your project to refine the visual appearance of the generated icons.

5. Select Your Favorite Icon

   * After making adjustments, select the icon you like the most.

     ![](/assets/images/select-the-icon-ccd152f8d041d56c8e41069042c0d59e.png)

6. Crop the Icon

   * Once you’ve chosen your icon, you’ll have the option to crop it to fit the required dimensions.

7. Apply the Icon

   * Сlick Apply to set the selected icon in your project.

   * The icon will now appear in the Project Settings and be used for your Lens.

     ![](/assets/images/Apply-9329e8fb3a7c85f1b15410071d675425.png)

## Photoshop Template[​**](#photoshop-template "Copy to clipboard")

Download the Photoshop Lens icon template below to create your Lens' icon.

You can use the [PHOTOSHOP - Lens Icon Template](https://storage.googleapis.com/snapchat-lens-assets/f1a09194-f02d-43ed-92b8-62e843179ff0/lensStudio/lens_icon_template_photoshop.zip) to get started.

Open the template within Adobe Photoshop. Replace the content in the layer labeled `[REPLACE ME]`. This will mask your content within a circle. Additionally, you can tune the background color by adjusting the `Color Overlay` effect on the `Color BG` layer.

![Creating an Icon Layers](/assets/images/creating-an-icon_creating_an_icon_world_ps_layers-73987c14715989cc079965cc061bf53e.png)

To export your icon, select `File -> Export -> Export As...` and select `PNG` as the export format.

![Creating an Icon Export](data:image/png;base64,)

## Illustrator Template[​**](#illustrator-template "Copy to clipboard")

Download the Illustrator Lens icon template below to create your Lens's icon.

You can use the [Illustrator - Lens Icon Template](https://storage.googleapis.com/snapchat-lens-assets/f1a09194-f02d-43ed-92b8-62e843179ff0/lensStudio/lens_icon_template_illustrator.zip) to get started.

Open the template within Adobe Illustrator. Replace the content in the layer labeled `[REPLACE ME]`. This layer has a clipping mask which masks the content to a circle. Additionally, you can tune the background color by adjusting the color of the `Frame BG` layer.

![Creating an Icon Layers](data:image/png;base64,)

To export your icon, select `File -> Export -> Export for Screens` and select `PNG` as the export format.

![](data:image/png;base64,)
